title: PVB repair kit: verify the assembly and service family before ordering
description: PVB kit selection depends on exact model, size, configuration, and condition.
prompt: Does this PVB have a verified model-specific service kit and a sound body?
answer: PVB kit selection depends on exact model, size, configuration, and condition. Because many PVBs are exposed irrigation assemblies, freeze damage and support or piping damage must be ruled out before internal service is priced.
urgency: Do not install internal parts into a cracked, freeze-damaged, or unidentified PVB. Escalate when elevation, access, or retest requirements are unresolved.
identifiers: Capture bonnet and body labels, test cocks, shutoffs, and adjacent irrigation piping.
Check for cracks and freeze damage before assuming the internal kit is enough.
Confirm model-specific parts and post-service testing requirements.

choices.label: I know the model and size
choices.detail: Use model-specific sources before ordering parts or accepting a repair scope.

choices.label: The assembly is leaking or failed
choices.detail: Document the location and obtain a qualified diagnosis before repair.

choices.label: The body may be damaged
choices.detail: Compare repair with a complete replacement and retest scope.

steps.title: Observe and identify
steps.body: Document the model, size, orientation, and all visible damage.

steps.title: Match the verified path
steps.body: Match the official service kit only after body and piping condition are assessed.

steps.title: Close the risk loop
steps.body: Plan certified retest and required reporting after repair completion.

safeChecks: Avoid forcing frozen or seized components.
Keep air openings and test access clear.
Use the exact manufacturer part path for the installed model.
stopConditions: The body or piping is split or cracked.
The PVB model and orientation cannot be confirmed.
notThisDevice: A product-family name alone does not establish component compatibility.
A generic online part listing is not a repair diagnosis.
This page does not replace a qualified on-site assessment.
evidenceNote: Use exact manufacturer literature and the governing utility or authority record to validate the device, service path, and compliance closeout.
